operations.text: The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **condenses** this distinction between the approachable limit of inquiry and the relation renewed by determining. Its four lines remain one authorial form. This concept returns the reader to the operation which makes the compact distinction exact; the poem-like form does not replace its performance.

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **condenses** the recurrence through determination and the continuing relation of faith. The gap survives inquiry’s actual gains because their present enactment is not exhausted by their account. The complete four-line form returns that distinction to inquiry and answerable commitment.

operations.heading: ## Anchor and transition
operations.text: The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **condenses** the authorial relation carried through A03 and A23: investigation makes determinations; faith consciously continues through their non-exhaustion of ground. Its whole four-line movement remains available as a contemplation object. Each historical response in this Movement retains its own method and warrant.
